diagnostic_policy.collision_scan: Includes text below the body band to detect overprinted content intruding into the footer; only isolated numeric page labels are excluded.
diagnostic_policy.sparse_threshold: At most3 body text lines and160 characters without images; image-only pages are separately identified.
diagnostic_policy.overlap_threshold: At least10 pairs, each overlapping30% of the smaller line height and25% of its width, affecting at least12% of body lines.
diagnostic_policy.limitations: Review diagnostics only. Intentional title/frontmatter pages and some equations may be flagged; other defects may be missed. Explicit sparse-page exceptions never suppress dense-overlap diagnostics. Zero findings does not replace visual review.
